real_defects.issue: buildCode gave an M or N Marriage Allowance code (1383M / 1131N at 60,000) to higher-rate taxpayers, who can neither give nor receive it (Scotland: above the intermediate rate). Now gated at 12,570 + 37,700 (Scotland + 31,092) with a finding; test 'a higher-rate taxpayer can neither give nor receive Marriage Allowance'.

K codes ignored the 50% overriding limit: K3000 on 1,000 of monthly pay expected 771.60 tax, so a payslip correctly capped at 500 was flagged 'high: ask payroll'. taxToDate now caps K-code tax at 50% of pay to date, with a finding showing the uncapped figure; test 'K code tax is capped at 50% of pay'.
